task.title: On the SMS web application
task.shortdesc: To access a motor’s information page:

context.p: To access a motor’s information page:

step.cmd: Log in to the SMS web application.
On the left navigation menu, select a motor to view its corresponding motor information page.

info.note: Note: Alternatively, you can select a motor from the List view to view the motor’s information page.
info.p: This page also displays a cross-sectional image of the inner components of the selected motor.
info.note: Note: If any component needs repair or maintenance, that component is highlighted in red or yellow.
info.p: To view an image of the motor and its nameplate:

step.cmd: Click the placeholder icon on the top right of the page.

result.p: The corresponding motor’s image and its nameplate are displayed.
